result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a sidewalk but no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. The wide corner radius and lack of crossing infrastructure increase pedestrian exposure when crossing the multi-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The sweeping curb design allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a two-lane residential road completely lacking pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to use the unpaved shoulder or the roadway itself, creating a high-risk environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or paved shoulders, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the roadway.

hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians to traverse the two-lane road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on at least one side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs at appropriate intervals.

interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
